unit: Source filing excerpts, repeated across extraction tasks; NOT events, custodian notices or voting instructions.

fields.issuer: Publisher company/ticker; missing company completed only from a single consistent company value in the same source filing, with reference record ID. Not independently verified.
fields.country: UNKNOWN: SEC filing does not prove issuer domicile
fields.dates: not mapped; fiscal years and historic dates are not deadlines
fields.labels: output contains generated extraction targets, NOT verified votability labels; excluded from model

near_duplicate_method: Complete exact Jaccard threshold join at 0.85 using global-frequency prefix filtering and integer comparisons; numeric-masked five-word shingles; transitive and same-filing union. Does not detect every semantic paraphrase.
language_detection: langdetect heuristic, seed=0; requires human verification

leakage: Extraction instruction, output, task labels and publisher confidence never enter Laya. Same source filing and duplicate groups allocated together.
taxonomy: Provisional factorised schema: voting eligibility, independent restrictions, deadline status. Seven operational statuses are derived with explicit precedence. Public excerpts cannot validate exclusivity.
limitations: US regulatory filing excerpts overrepresent compensation and historical governance; not comprehensive global corporate-action coverage.
No human-verified votability labels. Accuracy and safe automation remain unknown.
Publisher generated extraction targets with Gemma; these targets are not used as ground truth or model input. No external inference in this application.
grouping_correction: An independent exact audit found two cross-split near-duplicate pairs and seventeen ungrouped pairs in the initial LSH protocol. Splits were rebuilt before any human labels or training; old source and profile versions are retained.
